limits: CPU is process CPU time relative to one logical core, not a full host percentage or engine-tick duration.
RSS is resident process memory; the peak is a process-lifetime high-water mark.
No packet capture, packet count, throughput, multiplayer RTT, frame latency or native client FPS was measured.
UDP queue/drop samples do not establish zero network loss, zero latency or a sustained queue maximum.
Tick, visibility, refresh and social payload counters were not yet written; none is inferred from CPU or sample timing.
The sample alone does not establish whole-match performance or Human/model gameplay acceptance.
scope: One actual 15-second dedicated-process sample, with Exploration confirmed by the native operator at its start. No live private player state was read.
